# Introduction

This document includes supplementary data and computational details related to the paper "Effects of ... ". 


## Project organisation

This notebook is built from source code available at the github repository [trainome/alpha-omega-trial](https://github.com/trainome/alpha-omega-trial/).  

### R scripts

- `R/fig-opt-fun.R` - Helper functions and settings for data visualisations.
- `R/helpers.R` - Helper functions for modelling.
- `R/packages.R` - Loading required packages.
- `R/data-prep.R` - Prepares data for the Metabolic syndrome analysis.
- `R/sim-fun.R` - Functions related to simulation studies. 


### Stan models

All Stan model scripts are stored in `/models/`. If model code is executed locally, model executables are also stored here. Model fits are stored in `fits/` but not pushed to github due to their large size.  

### Reproducibility

The project uses renv for a snapshot
